payload.classificationContract: Partition: ERROR on request/identity/value-schema failure; else COMPLETE if two valid values; PARTIAL if one; NULL if neither valid and any explicit null; MISSING otherwise. Any-null and any-absent flags retained separately, including partial/mixed cases. No imputation.
payload.readinessContract: READY_AS_PRIMARY only at complete 100% coverage with no errors; READY_WITH_MISSINGNESS_PROTOCOL if some complete coverage and no unresolved errors; NOT_READY if zero usable or unresolved error census. This is data access readiness only; no model/formula/missingness treatment selected.
payload.commonMissingMeaning: No valid values on either team (including null and statistics unavailable). Special MISSING excludes the separate NULL class. Any-null/any-absent counters overlap COMPLETE/PARTIAL/etc and are not added to the exclusive special totals.
payload.coverageDenominator: All 2892 frozen fixtures; coverage numerator requires both exact team blocks to have valid non-null values; no survivor denominator.

rights.evidence: User-reported provider dashboard Chat AI summary in previous gate; not upgraded.

temporal.interpretation: Only prior completed fixtures may enter a future V3 target after the future protocol availability rule. No lag, feature window, imputation or feature formula chosen.
